You can enjoy an all-inclusive wellness experience at Serenity Eco Guesthouse and Yoga Bali. We offer a flexible "All Inclusive/Full Board Package" that can be added to any accommodation, from budget-friendly backpacker dorms to private guesthouses. For an extra 680k IDR per person, per day, the package includes:

  • All-you-can-eat vegan meals: Healthy breakfast, lunch, and dinner at our on-site Alkaline Restaurant. See menu here

  • Unlimited Yoga Pass: Full access to our daily yoga schedule with 9 sessions per day.

  • Eco-Friendly Stay: Access to our pool, permaculture garden, and smoke/alcohol-free sanctuary. See accommodation here backpacker and guesthouse.
